title: Image and inverse-image identities of the filtered cycle class map
statement: Let C be an abelian category, K a cochain complex and L a decreasing filtration. For integers p,n set A=L.complexStep p n, A′=L.complexStep (p+1) n, Z=ker(K.d n (n+1)), B=im(K.d (n-1) n), and S=A∩Z. Let c:S→K.cycles n satisfy c followed by the cycle inclusion = S.arrow, and set f=c followed by K.homologyπ n. Then imageSubobject f=(L.cohomologyImage n).step p, and the inverse image under f of (L.cohomologyImage n).step (p+1) equals the restriction to S of (A∩B)+(A′∩Z).

source.place: Section 12.24, Equation 12.24.5.2 and the final quotient calculation of Lemma 12.24.6.

proof.text: Identify the image of the induced cycles map followed by the ambient cycle inclusion with A intersection Z. One inclusion follows from differential compatibility; for the other, factor the intersection through the degreewise monic subcomplex inclusion and lift to its cycles, using monicity in degree n+1. Factor the induced cycles map through this intersection; its image is the whole intersection, so the factor is epic. The equation defining c and monicity of the ambient cycle inclusion identify its composite with c. Naturality of homologyπ, and invariance of images under epic precomposition, give image(f)=I_n^p. Repeat with p+1 to express I_n^(p+1) as the image under homologyπ of the restriction of A′ intersection Z to the ambient cycles.

For an epimorphism q, use that q is a cokernel of its kernel, compare this cokernel with the standard cokernel projection, and apply the proved cokernel inverse-image identity to obtain q⁻¹(q(T))=ker(q)+T. The homology cokernel sequence toCycles followed by homologyπ is exact; hence mapping the kernel of homologyπ along iCycles yields the image of the incoming differential B. Mapping the inverse image of the next cohomology image step along iCycles consequently gives B+(A′ intersection Z). Reuse pullback_exists_isCokernel from FilteredNormalizedQuotientPresentation (whose proof uses pullback_exists_iso), imported with import all; all other categorical identities here are proved in Mathlib or WeilConjectures. Image composition uses the existing proved exists_image helper from FilteredComplexFirstPageCyclesBoundaries, imported with import all rather than restated.

Antitonicity gives A′ contained in A, while the boundary identity gives B contained in Z. Reuse the proved subobject_modular helper from FilteredNormalizedQuotientPresentation, together with its map_pullback_mono helper for restriction along a monomorphism. Apply it with S=A intersection Z and T=A′ intersection Z to get S intersection (B+T)=(A intersection B)+T. Compose the pullbacks using c followed by iCycles = S.arrow, and use injectivity of the subobject map along the monomorphism S.arrow to conclude the required inverse-image equality.

from.place: Cycle class map image and inverse image before taking cokernels

lean.statement:
theorem cohomologyImage_cycle_map
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : CochainComplex C ℤ} (L : DecreasingFiltration K) (p n : ℤ)
    (c : ((L.complexStep p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥ :
      Subobject (K.X n)) : C) ⟶
      K.cycles n)
    (hc : c ≫ K.iCycles n =
      (L.complexStep p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥).arrow) :
  let A := L.complexStep p n
  let A' := L.complexStep (p + 1) n
  let Z := (Subobject.pullback (K.d n (n + 1))).obj ⊥
  let B := imageSubobject (K.d (n - 1) n)
  let f := c ≫ K.homologyπ n
  imageSubobject f = (L.cohomologyImage n).step p ∧
    (Subobject.pullback f).obj ((L.cohomologyImage n).step (p + 1)) =
      (Subobject.pullback (A ⊓ Z).arrow).obj ((A ⊓ B) ⊔ (A' ⊓ Z))
